releaseValidation.activation: Buyer creates an evaluation and sends one seller invitation.
releaseValidation.completion: Buyer records a selection after one submitted seller response.
releaseValidation.timeToValue: Elapsed time from evaluation creation to immutable selection record.
releaseValidation.abandonment: Pilot exits before response submission or selection.
releaseValidation.trust: Buyer confirms the retained result and evidence are sufficient to defend the decision.
releaseValidation.reliability: Journey, recovery, rollback, and access-enforcement checks pass for one commit.
releaseValidation.support: Pilot completes without unplanned data repair and every support intervention is recorded.

releaseValidation.activation: A second buyer-team member accepts access and contributes to an evaluation.
releaseValidation.completion: A multi-role team completes scoring and selection with attributable changes.
releaseValidation.timeToValue: Elapsed time from second-member activation to team-completed selection.
releaseValidation.abandonment: Team stalls after member activation or requires manual conflict repair.
releaseValidation.trust: Team accepts role enforcement, attribution, and final scoring integrity.
releaseValidation.reliability: Concurrency, notification, and recovery checks pass under team use.
releaseValidation.support: Collaboration support burden stays within the pilot threshold set before entry.

releaseValidation.activation: A returning buyer starts from retained work or a reusable template.
releaseValidation.completion: A repeat evaluation produces and uses a decision report.
releaseValidation.timeToValue: Repeat-run duration compared with the buyer's first completed run.
releaseValidation.abandonment: Repeat flow falls back to unstructured manual setup.
releaseValidation.trust: Buyer and operations reviewer accept report accuracy and retained history.
releaseValidation.reliability: Export, retention, restore, admin, and support checks pass.
releaseValidation.support: Repeat and reporting support burden stays within the predeclared pilot threshold.

releaseValidation.activation: An approved seller is discoverable in the bounded pilot category.
releaseValidation.completion: A buyer engages a qualified match and the seller receives the opportunity.
releaseValidation.timeToValue: Elapsed time from buyer discovery intent to qualified seller engagement.
releaseValidation.abandonment: Buyer exits discovery without a trusted candidate or seller declines due to poor fit.
releaseValidation.trust: Pilot users accept match provenance, seller credibility, and abuse controls.
releaseValidation.reliability: Ingestion, matching replay, moderation, rollback, and recovery checks pass.
releaseValidation.support: Moderation and marketplace support load stays within the pilot threshold.

releaseValidation.activation: An opted-in user invokes an intelligence, scenario, TCO, or agent capability.
releaseValidation.completion: The assisted workflow produces a human-reviewed decision artifact.
releaseValidation.timeToValue: Assisted completion time compared with the unassisted baseline.
releaseValidation.abandonment: User rejects or bypasses the assisted workflow before reviewed output.
releaseValidation.trust: Human reviewer accepts provenance, control, and output quality.
releaseValidation.reliability: Evaluation, safety, cost, fallback, replay, and recovery checks pass.
releaseValidation.support: Agent-related support and correction load stays within the pilot threshold.

releaseValidation.activation: An enterprise design partner connects an agreed identity or integration path.
releaseValidation.completion: The partner completes the scoped enterprise journey in its required region and control boundary.
releaseValidation.timeToValue: Elapsed time from enterprise setup start to accepted controlled operation.
releaseValidation.abandonment: Partner blocks on identity, integration, compliance, residency, or scale evidence.
releaseValidation.trust: Partner accepts the supplied compliance and operational control evidence.
releaseValidation.reliability: Integration, residency, scale, rollback, and recovery checks pass.
releaseValidation.support: Enterprise support load and escalation paths meet the agreed pilot threshold.
